title: Enforce pre-edit checkpoint evidence before implementation
outOfScope: Changing a release tag, next-release candidate, provider release, archive, public assets, or publication state.
Resuming, merging, or closing Dependabot #441; it remains paused until this Work Item closes.
Weakening quality, supply-chain, release-distribution, or checkpoint validation.
Changing unrelated dependencies, workflows, installer behavior, or external release assets.

sources.reason: The checkpoint recorder currently accepts a before_edit record without distinguishing a late record after completed verification.
The risk gate detected the missing checkpoint but only at ai-finish, after the expensive quality gate had completed.
The paused RFE-093 fix must be repeated under an honest before_edit checkpoint and validates the source-bound evidence transaction.
The canonical plan records RFE-ISSUE-093 and requires process correction before later release work resumes.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item modifies governance entrypoints and source-bound local evidence, but must preserve release identity and provider state.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized continuous work; the failed lifecycle identifies a bounded process defect and the source-bound evidence fix is already characterized by a red-first regression.

preReviewWarnings: A before_edit checkpoint must be produced by the canonical preparation command before source, test, or generated-evidence changes.
Only the two computed release.json supplyChain digests may change during candidate evidence refresh.

checkpointPolicy.reason: A pre-edit checkpoint must be both recorded before validation results and structurally distinguishable from a late completion record.

acceptance: A canonical make entrypoint runs a ready preflight and writes the before_edit checkpoint to the active Summary before implementation begins.
The agent-risk gate rejects a before_edit checkpoint whose requiredChecksPassed proves it was recorded after verification began, with a red-first regression.
The instructions and generated command help point code Work Items to the canonical preparation entrypoint without relaxing ai-finish's independent verification.
The RFE-093 transaction has a red-first release-projection regression and writes SBOM, provenance, the two release.json digest fields, and release-digests in that dependency order.

Release identity, publication, security, archive, and provider fields remain unchanged; source-bound evidence, Capability Truth, and Japanese assessment are regenerated from the final Work Item source.

Before #441 resumes, this Work Item has archived Contract/Summary evidence, a PR whose exact head passes required Hosted CI, a merged PR, and a successful ai-close-work-item record proving local/remote branch cleanup.
guidelines: Do not fabricate a before_edit event after implementation; make the record's timing evidence reviewable and fail closed.
Keep the preparation command deterministic and local; it must not query or mutate provider release state.
Preserve release identity and publication fields; synchronize only the computed local digest projection.
Keep validation gates fail closed; no test, check, or release constraint may be removed or relaxed.
Record the execution-process deviation and replacement lifecycle in bidirectional instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability.

intent.problem: A required before_edit checkpoint was omitted and was detected only after a full five-minute quality run. Recording it after the fact would falsify the lifecycle, while the paused RFE-093 source-bound evidence fix must be delivered without repeating the omission.
constraints: Do not manufacture or backdate checkpoint evidence.
Do not weaken ai-finish, agent-risk, quality, or release-distribution gates.
Do not change release identity, tag, archive, provider state, or public assets.
Keep the Work Item bounded to checkpoint process enforcement and the dependent RFE-093 corrective replay.
intent.rationale: A canonical preparatory entrypoint plus a regression that rejects late evidence moves detection before costly implementation and prevents an agent from converting a missed lifecycle step into an apparently valid completion record.

rawUserRequest: Continue without stopping unless confirmation is genuinely required. When a process problem is found, fix the process before resuming work; prevent omissions through instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability.

declaredIntent.summary: Prevent late or fabricated pre-edit checkpoint evidence and replay the linked source-bound release-projection corrective under the repaired process.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A ready code Work Item has no before_edit checkpoint.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The canonical preparation command records before_edit immediately after preflight and before source, tests, or generated evidence change.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a temporary Contract/Summary regression that invokes the preparation command and asserts the checkpoint record is present with zero completed required checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An agent attempts to record before_edit only after verification has completed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The agent-risk gate rejects the late record instead of allowing ai-finish/archive to continue.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Write a red-first agent-risk unit test with requiredChecksPassed greater than zero for before_edit.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A workflow/dependency pin changes source-bound SBOM and provenance.
scenarioCoverage.expected: One refresh updates local evidence and release.json digest projection without changing release identity/publication fields.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Replay the RFE-093 temporary-path unit regression and focused release-distribution tests.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuous process corrective work before resuming #441.
